item.title: President Trump wants the US to carry out more than 1,000 space launches a year by 2030 — and speed up sending robots and humans to Mars
item.description: Trump signs memo pushing America toward 1,000 annual space launches by 2030, boosting access to land and NASA's moon plans.

item.title: The US is now home to 15 of the world's 20 biggest AI data centers — with one state housing 12 on its own
item.description: The US dominates global hyperscale infrastructure, while Texas and emerging markets gain importance as operators seek locations supporting continued AI expansion.
